item_specifications.special_feature: Easy to Clean, Non Skid Bottom, Orthopedic, Removable Cover, Waterproof

about_item: 【Orthopedic Support】Made with 3.5-inch high-density egg crate foam and memory foam, this extra large orthopedic dog bed provides even weight distribution, relieves joint pressure, and supports muscles—ideal for dogs of all sizes, especially seniors or those with arthritis. Soft, supportive, and cozy for restful sleep.

【360° Bolstered Support】Designed with a 360° full-surround bolster, this orthopedic dog bed creates a secure, enclosed space—perfect for dogs who love to curl up or lean against something. The overstuffed bolsters provide head and neck support from all sides, promoting better sleep and full-body comfort in any position.

【Cozy & Calming Sleep Surface】Crafted with a plush fish-scale pattern, the sleeping surface is ultra-soft, cozy, and gentle on your pet’s skin. The durable corn-kernel textured exterior ensures long-lasting use, while the calming, skin-friendly fabric helps ease anxiety and encourages deep, restful sleep.

【Waterproof & Easy to Clean】This dog bed is designed with a waterproof inner lining that protects the foam from spills, accidents, and everyday moisture. The outer cover features a smooth double zipper design and is fully removable, making cleanup quick and easy. Just unzip, toss it in the washing machine, and enjoy a clean, fresh bed for your furry friend.

【Perfect Size for Large Breeds】 Measuring 42" x 32" x 7.5" (4" bolstered side ), this large dog bed is ideal for large to extra large dogs weighing up to 90 lbs. Designed for pets who love to stretch out or curl up, it provides plenty of room for restful sleep. The big dog bed is vacuum-packed for shipping—please allow up to 6 hours to fully expand and regain its original shape after opening.
【Non-Slip Bottom for Safety】 Features a durable anti-slip base that keeps pet bed firmly in place on hardwood, tile, and other smooth floors—no more sliding when your dog jumps on or off.

authors_reviews.title: Great quality dog bed.
authors_reviews.text: This is by far one of the best dog beds that we have bought! It is a little tough to zip up, but worth how great it is to wash. The foam is better quality than usual, with more firmness which will definitely last longer. We have 4 dogs all different sizes that exchange beds, so we will be getting bigger sizes of this type to fit them all.
authors_reviews.author: Josh

authors_reviews.title: Comfortable
authors_reviews.text: I have a 55 lb Siberian Husky and she LOVES IT. & her sister too! They both fit together in this one bed.Quality : Great! It's soft and comfortable!Highly recommend this item!

authors_reviews.title: Great beds!
authors_reviews.text: Sizing was perfect! Quick delivery and easy to put together. I love that the zipper is on the outside of the beds so dogs that occasionally dig in the bed will not catch it and damage. Great colors too. The light brown hides our dirt well.
authors_reviews.author: Becky Batson

authors_reviews.title: Great Bed for the Money

authors_reviews.title: Good quality so far
authors_reviews.text: My dog is almost ~70lbs & I got the XL dog bed. It’s a perfect size for him. The sides/edges actually seem pretty sturdy and hold up well. I wish the inside material was made up of something else. I find that this particular material (soft & furry) gets matted when not cleaned often enough but it looks comfy.
authors_reviews.author: Preetika Pai

authors_reviews.title: Great purchase!
authors_reviews.text: This bed is wonderful. I bought two of the XXL and a size smaller. My girls like to cuddle and the boy likes to bring all of the toys to bed. The firmness is great for my senior girl to rest her tired body after playing and running with the puppy/little brother. Washing the beds is a breeze. The cover is easy to remove and easy to reassemble. Great bed, great buy.
authors_reviews.author: JADA

authors_reviews.title: Good support, nice bed!
authors_reviews.text: My 80 pound long-legged, big chested boy enjoys this bed. He likes to curl up into the corners so the bolster was a necessity! Plenty of space for him in the middle. The cover is soft and high quality. The middle is quite supportive - you can feel the egg-crate texture if you press on it. The gray color and shape looks nice anywhere in the house, as well.
authors_reviews.author: Tiffany G.
